title: Stir-Fried Jade Noodles with Cai and Pork
description: A simple and flavorful Chinese-inspired dish made with stir-fried jade noodles, cai, and pork.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet and stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger.
Add the chopped cai to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Add the cooked jade noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until combined with the cai and garlic mixture.
Return the cooked pork to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the pork is coated in the soy sauce mixture.
Serve the stir-fried noodles and pork hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
